scope: Review of the static IFPMIC progress page, its retained browser verification and captures, and the cited status sources. This does not accept product behavior, H2 execution, full490, or the overall goal.

cross_checks.served_files: The verification records 10 directly referenced local files served byte-identically to source; the associated source manifest has 13 entries including the page and supporting review/data documents. All 13 recorded hashes match current bytes.
cross_checks.screenshots: Both recorded screenshot hashes match their PNG files. Visual inspection at 1440x1080 and 390x844 found the status figures, both delivery cards, blocker list, and links readable without horizontal overflow or clipping.
cross_checks.progress: progress.json records 16 stages with V0 and V1 as the only verified stages. The displayed 2/16 and 12.5% are accurate and are explicitly described as an unweighted stage count, not work or time completion.
cross_checks.iteration_01: The page identifies the existing design explorer and 74-scenario synthetic replay as a demo, and labels its screenshot as a dated prior capture rather than live execution evidence.
cross_checks.iteration_02: The page describes actual local API/PostgreSQL request persistence with synthetic account and mock profile, and explicitly says execution is not connected. Its screenshot is dated as a prior capture.
cross_checks.iteration_03: The cited full-input verification reports 140 passed synthetic units with exit code 0 and iteration03_accepted=false. The page says actual490 is unexecuted and shows no execution-admission UI.
cross_checks.blockers: The three displayed blockers match the attempt-02 review findings: FULL-STOPPED-BOUNDARY-LABEL-IS-NOT-REGISTRY-ROLE, FULL-SYNTHETIC-CLEANUP-JOURNAL-IS-NOT-CLI, and FULL-RETAINED-H1-README-ANCHOR-DRIFT.

verification_observations.desktop_viewport: 1440x1080; no horizontal overflow; 2 images loaded; details control toggles with keyboard.
verification_observations.mobile_viewport: 390x844; no horizontal overflow; 2 images loaded; details control toggles with keyboard.

limitations: The browser check reviewed here is the recorded run; it was not repeated during this review.
The two existing application pages were checked for HTTP availability only; their application behavior and persistence were not rerun.
The page is a dated static progress record, not a live status feed. The two screenshots are historical captures from 2026-10-20 KST.
The 140-unit result is synthetic-only for its pinned scope. The current three blockers remain open; fresh490 execution and its approval gates remain pending.
No new workflow behavior, full H2 acceptance, H3-H7 acceptance, or original AT32 acceptance is established by this delivery.
review_method: Read-only cross-check of status-verification.json, its source hashes and direct-file checks, private reproduction-script logic, current progress/delivery documents, exact attempt-02 findings, and the desktop/mobile PNGs. No service, test suite, browser script, or full runner was started.
